as_told.title: Black Vault FOIA on fast walkers denied as exempt

plain: A researcher named John Greenewald Jr., who runs an archive of government records called the Black Vault, is said to have asked for files on "fast walkers" and been turned down. He used FOIA, a US law that lets anyone request government records, and "fast walkers" is a military term for unexplained objects seen moving quickly through space. Michels says that when Greenewald tried, NORAD, the North American air defence command, answered that this was "very sensitive material." A guest named Maaneli Derakhshani says Greenewald asked the Space Force and the Department of Defense for all documents on both "fast walkers and slow walkers" and that the request was refused under an exemption. If true, the military would be keeping records of unexplained objects in space and declining to release them.
